captions.caption: A wide, static shot shows a vast, empty desert landscape under a hazy sky.
A soldier wearing camouflage and a backpack rides a small dirt bike across the desert from left to right.
The soldier continues riding the dirt bike across the expansive, flat desert, kicking up dust.
The camera follows the soldier on the dirt bike as they speed across the cracked, dry earth.
The soldier on the dirt bike rides away from the camera, getting smaller in the frame.
The soldier on the motorcycle continues riding into the distance across the vast desert.
From a distance, the soldier on the dirt bike travels across the barren landscape.
The soldier on the dirt bike becomes a small figure riding towards the horizon.
A wide shot shows the empty, cracked desert landscape with tire tracks visible.
A large C-130 military transport plane lands on the desert floor, kicking up a cloud of dust.
The C-130 continues its landing roll, generating a larger cloud of dust behind it.
As the plane moves further away, the dust cloud behind it grows significantly.
The C-130 is almost completely engulfed by the massive cloud of dust it created.
The large dust cloud continues to expand, completely obscuring the plane from view.
A huge cloud of dust billows across the desert landscape in the wake of the plane.
The brown dust cloud continues to swirl and move across the cracked desert floor.
The thick, swirling cloud of dust dominates the frame, obscuring the horizon.
The massive dust cloud slowly begins to dissipate across the desert.
From a new angle, a C-130 flies low in the distance over the vast desert.
The C-130 continues its approach towards the camera, growing larger in the frame.
The military transport plane flies steadily towards the camera over the flat desert.
The C-130 gets closer, its shape becoming more defined against the pale sky.
The plane continues its low-level flight path directly towards the camera.
The C-130 is now much closer, flying just above the desert floor.
The large military plane continues its approach, preparing to land on the desert.
The C-130 is very close to the camera, still airborne over the cracked ground.
The transport plane gets even closer, with its landing gear clearly visible.
The C-130 is just moments from touching down on the cracked desert terrain.
The plane's rear wheels make contact with the ground, kicking up a small amount of dust.
The C-130 lands and begins its rollout, with dust beginning to trail behind it.
The plane continues rolling on the desert floor, creating a small cloud of dust.
The C-130 moves from right to left across the screen, kicking up more dust.
The plane continues its landing roll on the desert, with a growing dust cloud behind it.
A side view shows the C-130 slowing down on the vast desert terrain.
The dust cloud kicked up by the landing plane continues to grow in size.
The C-130 moves further to the left, still rolling and creating a large dust cloud.
The military plane continues its landing roll, becoming obscured by the billowing dust.
The plane is now further away as the dust cloud behind it becomes larger.
The tail of the C-130 is visible as it continues to move through the dust cloud.
The military plane is almost completely hidden by the massive cloud of dust.
A large cloud of dust billows across the desert in the plane's wake.
The dense dust cloud continues to expand and move across the landscape.
The thick dust cloud grows, obscuring more of the desert floor and the horizon.
The billowing cloud of brown dust continues to spread out across the desert.
The large cloud of dust continues to move across the desert landscape from left to right.
The swirling dust cloud fills a significant portion of the wide camera frame.
The dust cloud begins to drift away to the right, leaving the air hazy.
A new, closer shot shows the C-130 on the ground, seen through the dusty air.
The C-130 is stationary on the desert floor, its propellers spinning amidst the dust.
A close-up, head-on shot shows the C-130 with its propellers turning and lights on.
The C-130 sits on the desert ground, its bright lights shining through the dusty air.
A front view of the stationary C-130 shows its four propellers spinning rapidly.
A new wide shot shows the C-130 stationary in the distance on the desert floor.
The C-130 sits alone on the vast, empty desert landscape.
The stationary C-130 is seen from a distance with its propellers still spinning.
The wide shot holds on the C-130 sitting idle on the flat desert.
The C-130 remains stationary in the vast, empty desert expanse.
A wide view shows the C-130 military transport plane on the cracked desert floor.
The military transport plane sits idle on the barren, flat landscape.
The wide shot of the stationary C-130 in the desert continues.
